headline.zh: AI 代理的元年：2026 企业就绪度白皮书
headline.en: Year of the AI Agent: 2026 Enterprise Readiness Whitepaper

deck.zh: AI 代理从概念验证走向生产环境。我们的全球调研揭示了规模化部署的三大关键成功因素。
deck.en: AI agents move from POC to production. Our global survey reveals three critical success factors for deployment at scale.

zh: 代理架构模式：从单任务到多代理协作
安全与治理：代理权限、审计与人为干预
组织就绪度：技能、流程与文化变革
投资回报分析：代理 ROI 模型与基准
en: Agent Architecture: From single-task to multi-agent collaboration
Security & Governance: Agent permissions, audit, and human-in-the-loop
Organizational Readiness: Skills, processes, and culture change
ROI Analysis: Agent ROI models and benchmarks

zh: 到 2027 年，40% 的企业将部署 AI 代理
成功率最高的代理类型是内部知识检索
安全治理是规模化部署的首要障碍
en: 40% of enterprises will deploy AI agents by 2027
Highest success rate: internal knowledge retrieval agents
Security governance is the #1 barrier to scaling

headline.zh: IDP 的新定义：从构建平台到构建平台产品
headline.en: Redefining IDP: From Building a Platform to Building a Platform Product

deck.zh: 内部开发者平台的概念正在被重新定义。我们分析了 50+ 企业的最新平台工程实践。
deck.en: The IDP concept is being redefined. We analyze the latest platform engineering practices from 50+ enterprises.

zh: 平台即产品：用产品思维管理内部平台
开发者体验度量：DORA 之外的新维度
平台团队拓扑：哪种结构适合你的组织
投资回报模型：IDP 的三年总拥有成本分析
en: Platform-as-Product: Managing internal platforms with product thinking
DevEx Metrics: New dimensions beyond DORA
Platform Team Topologies: Which structure fits your org
ROI Models: Three-year TCO analysis for IDPs

zh: 平台即产品思维使采用率从 30% 提升至 80%
DevEx 指标应与业务 KPI 挂钩
平台团队不应超过工程团队的 10%
en: Platform-as-product mindset lifts adoption from 30% to 80%
DevEx metrics should tie to business KPIs
Platform teams should not exceed 10% of engineering

headline.zh: 从职能竖井到产品团队：亚洲制造业组织转型实录
headline.en: From Functional Silos to Product Teams: Inside Asian Manufacturing Transformations

deck.zh: 基于三家中国和日本制造业巨头的真实转型数据，我们提出了产品型组织转型的五阶段框架。
deck.en: Based on real transformation data from three manufacturing giants, we propose a five-stage framework for product-oriented org transformation.

zh: 诊断与设计：如何识别正确的产品领域边界
试点团队选取：为什么前 3 个团队决定成败
规模化推广：从 3 个团队到 150 个团队的路径
文化转型：激励机制、绩效考核与领导力
持续改进：OKR 复盘与组织健康度量
en: Diagnosis & Design: Identifying the right product domain boundaries
Pilot Selection: Why the first 3 teams determine success or failure
Scaling Out: From 3 to 150 teams
Culture: Incentives, performance review, and leadership
Continuous Improvement: OKR retrospectives and org health metrics

zh: 产品领域应以客户价值流而非技术栈划分
前 90 天的变革管理至关重要
领导者必须先转变自己的行为
en: Define product domains by customer value streams, not tech stacks
The first 90 days of change management are critical
Leaders must transform their own behavior first

headline.zh: 数据网格两年回顾：承诺、陷阱与实践者指南
headline.en: Data Mesh Two Years In: Promises, Pitfalls, and a Practitioner's Guide

deck.zh: 数据网格从热门概念走向实际落地。基于 30+ 实施项目的经验，我们复盘了什么有效、什么需要重新思考。
deck.en: Data mesh moves from hype to implementation. Based on 30+ project experiences, we review what works and what needs rethinking.

zh: 数据产品定义：什么是好的数据产品边界
联邦治理的实践：谁做什么、谁决策
技术选型困境：不想被锁定但也不想碎片化
组织变革：数据所有权下放的真正挑战
en: Data Product Definition: What makes a good data product boundary
Federated Governance in Practice: Who does what, who decides
Technology Dilemma: Avoiding lock-in without fragmentation
Org Change: The real challenge of decentralizing data ownership

zh: 数据产品应以消费端需求为起点而非数据源
联邦治理中最难的是建立信任而非技术
70% 的数据网格项目低估了组织变革难度
en: Start data products from consumer needs, not data sources
The hardest part of federated governance is trust, not technology
70% of data mesh projects underestimate org change difficulty

headline.zh: 2026 网络威胁格局：AI 攻防新战场
headline.en: 2026 Cyber Threat Landscape: The New AI Attack-Defense Battlefield

deck.zh: AI 既是武器也是盾牌。我们分析了 2026 年最重要的五类 AI 驱动的网络威胁及对应防御策略。
deck.en: AI is both weapon and shield. We analyze the five most significant AI-driven cyber threats of 2026 and defense strategies.

zh: AI 驱动的社会工程：超个性化钓鱼已达工业规模
深度伪造攻击：针对高管的语音和视频欺诈
供应链 AI 风险：第三方 AI 模型中的后门
防御性 AI 框架：从检测到自主响应
2026 全球网络安全监管趋势
en: AI-Driven Social Engineering: Hyper-personalized phishing at industrial scale
Deepfake Attacks: Voice and video fraud targeting executives
Supply Chain AI Risk: Backdoors in third-party AI models
Defensive AI: From detection to autonomous response
2026 Global Cybersecurity Regulatory Trends

zh: AI 钓鱼邮件的打开率是传统钓鱼的 3 倍
防御性 AI 的投资回报率 12 个月内可达 300%
零信任 + AI 检测是最有效的组合防御
en: AI phishing emails have 3x the open rate of traditional phishing
Defensive AI ROI can reach 300% within 12 months
Zero Trust + AI detection is the most effective combined defense

deck.zh: 年度旗舰报告：覆盖 30 个国家、12 个行业的 5,000 亿美元技术支出分析，含 AI、云、安全三年预测。
deck.en: Annual flagship: USD 500B tech spending analysis across 30 countries and 12 industries with 3-year forecasts.

zh: 全球技术支出总览：5,000 亿美元的市场图景
AI 投资趋势：从实验到规模化的转折点
云基础设施：多云策略成为主流
安全支出：增速首次超过整体 IT 支出
区域差异：亚太增速领先全球
行业基准：金融和制造业领跑 AI 投资
en: Global Tech Spending: The USD 500B landscape
AI Investment: Inflection point from experiment to scale
Cloud Infrastructure: Multi-cloud goes mainstream
Security Spending: Growing faster than overall IT for the first time
Regional Variations: APAC leads global growth
Industry Benchmarks: Financial services and manufacturing lead AI

zh: 2026 年全球 AI 支出将超过 3,000 亿美元
亚太区技术支出增速是全球平均的 1.5 倍
安全支出首次超过传统 IT 基础设施支出
en: Global AI spending will exceed USD 300B in 2026
APAC tech spending growth is 1.5x the global average
Security spending surpasses traditional IT infra for the first time

headline.zh: GenAI 在中国金融业的合规落地路径
headline.en: GenAI Compliance Pathways in Chinese Financial Services

deck.zh: 中国金融监管机构对生成式 AI 的态度日趋明确。本文提出符合最新监管指引的 GenAI 实施框架。
deck.en: Chinese financial regulators provide clearer guidance on generative AI. This article proposes a GenAI implementation framework.

zh: 监管环境分析：网信办、金监局、央行最新指引
合规实施框架：模型备案、数据本地化、算法审计
风控模型治理：生成式 AI 在风控中的可解释性要求
典型案例：银行智能客服与投研助手的合规实践
en: Regulatory Analysis: CAC, NFRA, PBOC latest guidance
Compliance Framework: Model registration, data localization, algorithm audit
Risk Model Governance: Explainability requirements for GenAI in risk control
Case Examples: Bank intelligent customer service and research assistant compliance

zh: 中国 GenAI 监管框架为全球最全面的之一
模型备案是进入金融 GenAI 市场的必要条件
人类在关键决策中必须保留最终决定权
en: China's GenAI regulatory framework is among the world's most comprehensive
Model registration is mandatory for financial GenAI market entry
Humans must retain final decision authority in critical decisions

headline.zh: Green Code：软件碳效率的工程实践
headline.en: Green Code: Engineering Practices for Software Carbon Efficiency

deck.zh: 可持续软件工程从理论走向工程实践。我们提出了可量化的绿色编码模式及对云成本的直接影响。
deck.en: Sustainable software engineering moves from theory to practice. We propose quantifiable green coding patterns and their impact on cloud costs.

zh: 碳感知架构：将碳强度信号纳入调度决策
能效编码模式：10 个降低 CPU/内存能耗的实践
云资源优化：合理调整、Spot 实例和自动缩放
测量与报告：SCI 评分与云碳足迹仪表板
en: Carbon-Aware Architecture: Integrating carbon intensity signals into scheduling
Energy-Efficient Patterns: 10 practices to reduce CPU/memory energy
Cloud Optimization: Rightsizing, Spot instances, and auto-scaling
Measurement & Reporting: SCI scores and cloud carbon dashboards

zh: 碳感知调度可在不增加成本的情况下减排 15-30%
绿色编码实践通常同时降低成本和碳排放
2027 年起欧盟将要求大型企业报告 IT 碳足迹
en: Carbon-aware scheduling can reduce emissions 15-30% at no extra cost
Green coding practices typically reduce both cost and carbon
EU will require large enterprises to report IT carbon footprint from 2027

headline.zh: 工程师体验的四个维度：超越工具与流程
headline.en: The Four Dimensions of Developer Experience: Beyond Tools and Processes

deck.zh: DevEx 已成为技术人才竞争的关键差异化因素。我们提出覆盖工具、流程、文化与职业的四维框架。
deck.en: DevEx has become a critical differentiator in tech talent competition. We propose a 4D framework: tools, process, culture, career.

zh: 工具维度：本地开发环境、CI/CD 反馈循环
流程维度：代码审查、部署流程和事件响应
文化维度：心理安全、学习文化和自主权
职业维度：成长路径、导师制和影响力
en: Tools: Local dev environment, CI/CD feedback loops
Process: Code review, deployment flow, incident response
Culture: Psychological safety, learning culture, autonomy
Career: Growth paths, mentorship, and impact

zh: 文化维度对工程师留任的影响最大
改善反馈循环的 ROI 高于购买新工具
DevEx 指标应成为工程主管的 KPI
en: Culture dimension has the largest impact on retention
Improving feedback loops has higher ROI than buying new tools
DevEx metrics should be engineering leaders' KPIs

headline.zh: 实时数据管道的七大反模式
headline.en: Seven Anti-Patterns in Real-Time Data Pipelines

deck.zh: 基于 100+ 企业实时数据处理系统诊断，我们总结最常见的设计错误及工程化解决方案。
deck.en: Based on diagnostics of 100+ real-time data systems, we summarize the most common design mistakes and engineering solutions.

zh: 架构反模式：Lambda 架构的隐性成本
数据质量陷阱：假设数据是干净的错误
运维反模式：缺乏可观测性的流处理系统
成本失控：Kafka 和 Flink 的十大省钱技巧
最佳实践：经过验证的实时管道参考架构
en: Architecture Anti-Patterns: Hidden costs of Lambda architecture
Data Quality Traps: The error of assuming clean data
Ops Anti-Patterns: Streaming systems without observability
Cost Runaway: Top 10 cost-saving tips for Kafka and Flink
Best Practices: Proven reference architecture for real-time pipelines

zh: Lambda 架构在 80% 的场景中应被 Kappa 架构取代
数据质量检查应占据管道代码的 30%
可观测性投资通常 6 个月内收回成本
en: Lambda architecture should be replaced by Kappa in 80% of cases
Data quality checks should comprise 30% of pipeline code
Observability investment typically pays back within 6 months

headline.zh: 技术尽调 2.0：AI 时代的并购新范式
headline.en: Tech DD 2.0: A New M&A Paradigm for the AI Era

deck.zh: 传统技术尽调已不足以评估 AI 公司价值。我们提出覆盖数据资产、模型质量与 AI 治理的全新框架。
deck.en: Traditional tech DD is insufficient for valuing AI companies. We propose a new framework covering data assets, model quality, and AI governance.

zh: 数据资产评估：数据质量、独家性与合规风险
模型质量审计：准确率、偏差、可复现性
AI 人才评估：团队密度与关键人物风险
技术债务量化：AI 系统的隐性维护成本
整合风险矩阵：文化、技术与监管的三维评估
en: Data Asset Valuation: Quality, exclusivity, and compliance risk
Model Quality Audit: Accuracy, bias, reproducibility
AI Talent Assessment: Team density and key person risk
Technical Debt Quantification: Hidden maintenance costs of AI systems
Integration Risk Matrix: 3D assessment of culture, technology, and regulation

zh: AI 公司的真正价值在于数据 + 人才而非模型本身
模型质量审计应成为 AI 并购的标准环节
70% 的 AI 并购失败源于文化整合问题
en: The real value of an AI company is data + talent, not the model
Model quality audit should be standard in AI M&A
70% of AI M&A failures stem from cultural integration issues

headline.zh: 关键基础设施 OT 安全：亚太视角
headline.en: OT Security for Critical Infrastructure: An Asia-Pacific Perspective

deck.zh: 亚太关键基础设施面临独特的 OT 安全挑战。本文提出基于 IEC 62443 的实用安全框架。
deck.en: Asia-Pacific critical infrastructure faces unique OT security challenges. This article proposes a practical IEC 62443-based framework.

zh: OT 威胁格局：亚太地区的独特攻击面
IEC 62443 实施路径：从评估到认证
IT/OT 融合安全：如何在不牺牲安全的情况下互联
区域合规要求：中国、日本、新加坡、澳大利亚
en: OT Threat Landscape: Unique attack surface in APAC
IEC 62443 Path: From assessment to certification
IT/OT Convergence: How to connect without compromising security
Regional Compliance: China, Japan, Singapore, Australia

zh: 亚太 OT 攻击年增长率达 40%
IEC 62443 认证可将保险费用降低 25%
网络分段是最有效的第一道防线
en: APAC OT attacks growing 40% annually
IEC 62443 certification can reduce insurance costs 25%
Network segmentation is the most effective first line of defense
